product.title: Private Bryce Canyon and Slot Canyon Full Day Hike

description.text: In Bryce Canyon National Park, Join Sundial Guides on this 6-8 hour PRIVATE hiking adventure exploring two famous locations. Best way to explore Bryce Canyon National Park and surrounding Grand Staircase of Escalante National Monument in one full day. Stops include Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument. You will hike in Bryce and then travel by 4x4 to a less-visited slot canyon in the Grand Staircase. Ideal for visitors basing near Bryce Canyon City who want a guided red-rock experience without coordinating park entrances, trailheads, or photo stops on their own.
